name: @jobleft/shell
description: The desktop shell (Tauri v2, Electron as the fallback). It starts the local server and opens the UI.

scripts.app:build: node scripts/pack.ts && CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$(cd ../.. && pwd)/.cache/cargo-target" node "$(node -p "require.resolve('@tauri-apps/cli/tauri.js', { paths: ['.'] })")" build --debug --bundles app
